A student cites this evidence: “The Fifteenth, Nineteenth, Twenty-fourth, and Twenty-sixth Amendments prohibit specified voting restrictions and broaden constitutional protection.” Which conclusion most precisely follows from that evidence?

Use only the evidence printed in this question. No previous page or lesson is required.

generalfeedback.text: The decisive rule is Constitutional expansion: The Fifteenth, Nineteenth, Twenty-fourth, and Twenty-sixth Amendments prohibit specified voting restrictions and broaden constitutional protection. Apply it to the named actor and facts, then test the relevant procedure or limit. The distractors either use the wrong participation principle, skip required reasoning, or claim power is unlimited.
